identification: Small colour print after Reg Mombassa (Chris O'Doherty), garden standpipe/tap with eyes, gum tree and hedge blocks at sunset; image about 10x13cm in a cream mount with orange fillet, black frame. Signature 'Reg Mombassa' in black ink below image, lower right; ink is even in weight with no pressure variation, so it looks more like a printed facsimile signature than a hand signature, but photos cannot prove it. No edition number or pencil title visible. Likely a small offset or giclee reproduction of a Mambo-era or later image, not one of the 300-edition numbered lithographs.

viewing_check: Look at the signature under a loupe or phone zoom: pencil or pen stroke with pressure variation and sitting on the paper (hand signed) versus uniform dots of print (facsimile). Check for pencil edition number, title or date in the margins, and take the print out of the frame if allowed to read the back for a gallery label, publisher or edition stamp (e.g. Mambo, Ken Done style gallery, Nicholas Hughes/Australian Galleries).
